documents.summary: 该文通过CRISPR筛选研究转录因子ASCL1的降解机制，但未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题核心方向无关。
documents.abstract: Lineage-defining transcription factors are key oncogenic drivers but remain difficult to target pharmacologically due to the absence of ligandable pockets. The molecular rules governing substrate recognition by large HECT ubiquitin ligases also remain incompletely understood, limiting efforts to exploit these enzymes for targeted protein degradation. Here we combine genome-wide CRISPR knockout screening with base editor tiling screens at amino acid resolution, both coupled to an endogenous knock-in reporter of the SCLC lineage oncogenic transcription factor ASCL1, to systematically interrogate the mechanisms governing its degradation. These complementary screens unbiasedly identify the HECT ubiquitin ligase HUWE1 as the dominant regulator of ASCL1 stability in small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and resolve a conserved C-terminal phospho-degron centered on Ser207 and terminal Trp/Phe residues that are required for HUWE1 docking and ubiquitin-mediated degradation. Unexpectedly, base editor screening further uncovers a previously unrecognized regulatory module within HUWE1: a short negatively charged helix that functions as an autoinhibitory gate controlling access of phospho-degron substrates to HUWE1. Charge-flipping mutations within this regulatory helix relieve autoinhibition and accelerate degradation of multiple HUWE1 phospho-degron substrates, including ASCL1 and the canonical HUWE1 substrate DDIT4. Stabilization of ASCL1 through degron disruption paradoxically impairs SCLC proliferation, revealing that dynamic proteasome-coupled turnover is required for transcription factor function. Together, these findings reveal molecular rules governing HUWE1 phospho-degron recognition and identify a regulatory gate controlling substrate engagement. They also illustrate a generalizable strategy for resolving degradation mechanisms of undruggable transcription factors in their endogenous cellular context. 谱系定义转录因子是关键的致癌驱动因子，但由于缺乏可配体结合的pocket，仍难以通过药理学手段靶向。大HECT泛素连接酶底物识别的分子规则也尚未完全阐明，这限制了利用这些酶进行靶向蛋白降解的努力。在此，我们结合全基因组CRISPR敲除筛选与氨基酸分辨率的碱基编辑器tiling筛选，两者均耦合至SCLC谱系致癌转录因子ASCL1的内源性knock-in报告基因，以系统性地探究调控其降解的机制。这些互补筛选无偏地鉴定出HECT泛素连接酶HUWE1是小细胞肺癌（SCLC）中ASCL1稳定性的主要调控因子，并解析了一个以Ser207和末端Trp/Phe残基为中心的保守C端磷酸化degron，该degron是HUWE1对接和泛素介导降解所必需的。出乎意料的是，碱基编辑器筛选进一步揭示了HUWE1内一个先前未被识别的调控模块：一个短负电荷螺旋，它作为自抑制门控，控制磷酸化degron底物对HUWE1的访问。该调控螺旋内的电荷翻转突变解除自抑制，并加速多个HUWE1磷酸化degron底物的降解，包括ASCL1和经典HUWE1底物DDIT4。通过degron破坏稳定ASCL1反而会损害SCLC增殖，揭示动态的蛋白酶体偶联转换是转录因子功能所必需的。总之，这些发现揭示了调控HUWE1磷酸化degron识别的分子规则，并鉴定了一个控制底物结合的门控。它们还阐明了一种在细胞内源性环境中解析不可成药转录因子降解机制的通用策略。

documents.title: Plasma Protein Binding Prediction under Scaffold Split: Tree Models, ChemBERTa, Graph Networks, and Late Fusion
meta: Pradyumna Kumar Pradhan
ChemRxiv
documents.summary: 该文研究小分子血浆蛋白结合预测，使用图神经网络和ChemBERTa等模型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或转录因子结合，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: From idea generation to testing, drug discovery is a lengthy and expensive process. Rather than chasing all of their molecule ideas, scientists prioritize certain molecules that are more likely to be successful, from synthesis to safety to therapeutic use. Machine learning and AI enable researchers to narrow their candidate choices by predicting important properties such as ADMET (Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion, and Toxicity). This study uses the Plasma Protein Binding (PPB) dataset from DeepChem’s MoleculeNet, with several graph neural networks (GNNs), ChemBERTa (a language model for SMILES strings of molecules), and fusions of these models. The performance of these neural models is compared against two standard tree-based models: Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost. Instead of random splitting of the dataset, this study evaluates the models based on scaffold splitting that separates molecules by the Bemis–Murcko scaffold and puts the entire group into only the training, validation, or test set. This study demonstrates that for the PPB dataset, GNNs and ChemBERTa models perform better than the tree models. On a mean basis, the fusion models perform better than the individual GNNs or ChemBERTa-only models. Random splitting on the RF model exhibits a better R2 score than on a scaffold-split dataset. Because under scaffold splitting the model predicts on unseen cores, the task becomes more difficult than under regular random splitting. 从想法生成到测试，药物发现是一个漫长且昂贵的过程。科学家们并非追逐所有分子想法，而是优先选择那些从合成、安全性到治疗用途更可能成功的特定分子。机器学习和人工智能使研究人员能够通过预测重要性质（如ADMET（吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性））来缩小候选范围。本研究使用来自DeepChem的MoleculeNet的血浆蛋白结合（PPB）数据集，结合多种图神经网络（GNNs）、ChemBERTa（一种用于分子SMILES字符串的语言模型）以及这些模型的融合。这些神经模型的性能与两种基于树的基准模型——随机森林（RF）和XGBoost——进行了比较。本研究未采用数据集的随机划分，而是基于支架划分（scaffold splitting）评估模型，该划分根据Bemis–Murcko支架分离分子，并将整个组仅放入训练集、验证集或测试集。研究表明，对于PPB数据集，GNNs和ChemBERTa模型的性能优于树模型。在均值基础上，融合模型的性能优于单独的GNNs或仅ChemBERTa模型。RF模型在随机划分下的R2分数优于支架划分数据集。由于在支架划分下，模型需对未见核心进行预测，该任务比常规随机划分更为困难。

documents.title: An MRI-Based Intratumoral and Peritumoral 2.5D Deep Learning Model for Predicting P53-Mutated Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Two-Center Study.
meta: Weng, Jingfei; Li, Pinxiong; Yao, Dinghua; He, Yuqing; Yang, Chun; Yang, Bin
Technology in cancer research & treatment
documents.summary: 该文利用MRI影像深度学习模型预测肝癌P53突变状态，属于临床诊断应用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或分子机制建模，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: IntroductionHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is the most common primary liver cancer with high mortality. TP53 is the most frequently mutated tumor-suppressor gene in HCC, and P53 mutations are associated with poor differentiation, vascular invasion, and lower survival. Preoperative noninvasive detection of P53-mutated HCC is critical for treatment planning and prognostic assessment. This study aimed to develop and validate a deep learning (DL) model for predicting P53 mutation status in HCC.MethodsIn this retrospective two-center study, 373 patients with pathologically confirmed HCC were enrolled from two institutions (Center 1: n=320; Center 2: n=53). The Center 1 cohort was randomly partitioned into a training cohort (n=256) and an internal test cohort (n=64). Patients from Center 2 constituted an independent external test cohort (n=53). We employed a 2.5D ResNet34 architecture to process three-channel dynamic contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (DCE-MRI). Separate deep learning models were constructed for intratumoral and peritumoral regions using both single-phase and multiphase (arterial, portal venous, and delayed) fusion sequences. Significant clinical variables were selected to build a Clinical model, which was subsequently integrated with the optimal deep learning model to create a Combined model. Model performance was assessed by the area under the curve (AUC), calibration curves, and decision curve analysis (DCA).ResultsMultiphase fusion models consistently outperformed their single-phase models. The peritumoral (5mm) fusion model (IntraPeri5mm_Fusion) outperformed the intratumoral fusion model, achieving AUCs of 0.881 (95% CI: 0.836-0.926), 0.772 (95% CI: 0.651-0.893), and 0.757 (95% CI: 0.624-0.891) on the training cohort, internal test cohort, and external test cohort, respectively. The Combined model yielded further incremental improvement, with AUCs reaching 0.886 (95% CI: 0.842-0.930), 0.805 (95% CI: 0.691-0.918), and 0.793 (95% CI: 0.668-0.918) across the respective cohorts.ConclusionsThe proposed 2.5D DL model based on DCE-MRI effectively predicts P53-mutated HCC. Integrating peritumoral features with clinical variables yields the best performance, offering a promising noninvasive tool for prognostic stratification and individualized therapeutic planning. 引言肝细胞癌（HCC）是最常见的原发性肝癌，死亡率高。TP53是HCC中最常突变的肿瘤抑制基因，P53突变与低分化、血管侵犯及较低生存率相关。术前无创检测P53突变型HCC对治疗规划和预后评估至关重要。本研究旨在开发并验证一种深度学习（DL）模型，用于预测HCC中的P53突变状态。方法在这项回顾性双中心研究中，共纳入来自两个机构的373例经病理确诊的HCC患者（中心1：n=320；中心2：n=53）。中心1队列被随机分为训练队列（n=256）和内部测试队列（n=64）。中心2的患者构成独立的外部测试队列（n=53）。我们采用2.5D ResNet34架构处理三通道动态对比增强磁共振成像（DCE-MRI）。分别针对瘤内和瘤周区域构建了使用单期和多期（动脉期、门静脉期和延迟期）融合序列的深度学习模型。选择显著的临床变量构建临床模型，随后将其与最优深度学习模型整合，形成联合模型。模型性能通过曲线下面积（AUC）、校准曲线和决策曲线分析（DCA）进行评估。结果多期融合模型始终优于其单期模型。瘤周（5mm）融合模型（IntraPeri5mm_Fusion）优于瘤内融合模型，在训练队列、内部测试队列和外部测试队列上的AUC分别为0.881（95% CI：0.836-0.926）、0.772（95% CI：0.651-0.893）和0.757（95% CI：0.624-0.891）。联合模型进一步带来增量改进，在相应队列中的AUC分别达到0.886（95% CI：0.842-0.930）、0.805（95% CI：0.691-0.918）和0.793（95% CI：0.668-0.918）。结论所提出的基于DCE-MRI的2.5D DL模型能有效预测P53突变型HCC。将瘤周特征与临床变量整合可获得最佳性能，为预后分层和个体化治疗规划提供了一种有前景的无创工具。

documents.title: Repurposing of lansoprazole and nitazoxanide as NR2F2 inhibitors in the gastric cancer cell line GCIY: computational insights and siRNA-mediated in vitro tests.
meta: Culletta, Giulia; Roomi, Muhammad Sohaib; Caricasulo, Maria Azzurra; Zanetti, Adriana; Terao, Mineko; Paroni, Gabriela; Garattini, Enrico; Tutone, Marco
Frontiers in chemistry
documents.summary: 该文通过计算虚拟筛选和siRNA实验，研究药物分子与核受体NR2F2（转录因子）的配体结合及转录活性调控，涉及蛋白-配体互作而非直接蛋白-DNA结合建模，方法上以计算筛选和实验验证为主，对TF-DNA互作课题仅有间接启发。
documents.abstract: BACKGROUND: Nuclear receptors (NRs) are a superfamily of ligand-activated transcription factors that mediate the cellular response to hormones, vitamins, and dietary lipids, thus orchestrating numerous physiological processes and influencing multiple disease states. Within this superfamily, NR2Fs, also known as Chicken Ovalbumin Upstream Promoter Transcription Factor (COUP-TF), are a family of nuclear orphan receptors, due to the lack of known endogenous ligands. Among them, NR2F2 transcription factor activities involve regulation of cell differentiation during organogenesis, maintenance of adult tissue homeostasis, and tumorigenesis. To date, only the CIA compounds have been identified as inhibitors of NR2F2 driven transcriptional activity in prostate cancer cell lines, with the IC50 of CIA1 falling in the lower muM range. METHODS: A comprehensive computational analysis has been conducted in order to gain insight into the inhibitory activity of the prototype CIA1 against NR2F2 at a molecular level. We leveraged the outputs of computational analysis to perform a virtual screening campaign to FDA compounds capable of binding to NR2F2. Luciferase reporter assay was used to functionally validate the interaction. RNA interference approaches were used to validate the specificity of NR2F2 activity on cell proliferation. RESULTS: We identified lapatinib, glyburide, nitazoxanide, and lansoprazole as modulators of NR2F2-dependent reporter activity. In the gastric cancer cell line GCIY, lansoprazole and nitazoxanide exert antiproliferative effects that are mitigated by NR2F2 silencing. The convergence between in silico predictions and LBD-dependent reporter modulation supports the interpretation that lapatinib, glyburide, nitazoxanide, and lansoprazole represent bona fide functional interactors of NR2F2. CONCLUSION: Taken together, our data extend current evidence that NR2F2 is a ligandable orphan receptor whose transcriptional output can be pharmacologically tuned. Moreover, our findings provide new chemical tools for probing NR2F2 biology and nominate clinically used molecules as starting points for therapeutic or repurposing strategies targeting NR2F2-dependent programs. 背景：核受体（Nuclear receptors, NRs）是一个配体激活的转录因子超家族，介导细胞对激素、维生素和膳食脂质的响应，从而协调众多生理过程并影响多种疾病状态。在该超家族中，NR2Fs，也称为鸡卵清蛋白上游启动子转录因子（COUP-TF），由于缺乏已知的内源性配体，属于核孤儿受体家族。其中，NR2F2转录因子活性涉及器官发生过程中的细胞分化调控、成体组织稳态维持以及肿瘤发生。迄今为止，仅CIA化合物被鉴定为前列腺癌细胞系中NR2F2驱动转录活性的抑制剂，其中CIA1的IC50处于低微摩尔范围。方法：为在分子水平上深入了解原型CIA1对NR2F2的抑制活性，我们进行了全面的计算分析。我们利用计算分析的输出结果，对FDA化合物进行了虚拟筛选，以识别能够结合NR2F2的候选物。使用荧光素酶报告基因实验进行功能验证相互作用。采用RNA干扰方法验证NR2F2活性对细胞增殖的特异性。结果：我们鉴定出拉帕替尼（lapatinib）、格列本脲（glyburide）、硝唑尼特（nitazoxanide）和兰索拉唑（lansoprazole）作为NR2F2依赖性报告基因活性的调节剂。在胃癌细胞系GCIY中，兰索拉唑和硝唑尼特发挥抗增殖作用，这些作用通过NR2F2沉默而减弱。计算机预测与LBD依赖性报告基因调节之间的趋同性支持了拉帕替尼、格列本脲、硝唑尼特和兰索拉唑代表NR2F2真正功能相互作用因子的解释。结论：综合来看，我们的数据扩展了现有证据，表明NR2F2是一个可配体的孤儿受体，其转录输出可通过药理学方式调节。此外，我们的发现为探究NR2F2生物学提供了新的化学工具，并提名临床使用的分子作为靶向NR2F2依赖性程序的治疗或再利用策略的起点。

documents.title: Multivalent cations stabilize DNA duplexes beyond charge neutralization.
meta: Chen, Yun-Long; Zheng, Chen-Chen; Zhang, Yan; Tan, Zhi-Jie; Zhang, Xing-Hua
Chemical science
documents.summary: 该文通过磁镊实验和全原子分子动力学模拟研究多价阳离子对DNA双链稳定性的影响，涉及DNA-离子互作机制，但非TF-DNA结合体系，方法包含MD模拟，对蛋白质-DNA互作建模有间接启发。
documents.abstract: Multivalent cations are abundant in cells and play essential roles in DNA duplex stability, genome packaging, and DNA-protein interactions. They can also condense DNA, making it challenging to determine their influence on DNA duplex stability. To overcome this challenge, we studied DNA unpeeling at equilibrium under high tension using magnetic tweezers, thereby preventing condensation. Experiments show that DNA duplex stability first increases and then decreases as cation concentration increases and the maximum DNA duplex stability increases with cation valence. The maximum free energy change of DNA was 3.33 k (B) T/bp for Na(+) and increased to 3.98 k (B) T/bp for protamine, which is a small arginine-rich protein with a highly positive charge ( approximately 21 for salmon sperm), corresponding to a relative increase of 19.5%. Consistently, all-atom molecular dynamics simulations show that higher-valent cations preferentially embed in the minor groove of DNA and clamp the minor groove, in contrast to the major-groove clamping reported for RNA, thereby stabilizing the helix more efficiently. These findings establish a single-molecule framework for quantifying DNA thermodynamics in complex ionic environments, which contributes to understanding ionic control of genome stability and to designing ion-tunable DNA-based nanostructures and delivery systems. 多价阳离子在细胞中含量丰富，并在DNA双链稳定性、基因组包装及DNA-蛋白质相互作用中发挥关键作用。它们也能凝聚DNA，从而难以确定其对DNA双链稳定性的影响。为克服这一挑战，我们利用磁镊在高张力下研究DNA在平衡状态下的解链过程，从而避免凝聚。实验表明，随着阳离子浓度增加，DNA双链稳定性先升高后降低，且最大DNA双链稳定性随阳离子价态升高而增加。DNA的最大自由能变化对于Na(+)为3.33 k(B)T/bp，而对于鱼精蛋白（一种富含精氨酸的小蛋白，带高正电荷，鲑鱼精子中约为21）则增至3.98 k(B)T/bp，相对增加19.5%。一致地，全原子分子动力学 (all-atom molecular dynamics) 模拟显示，高价阳离子优先嵌入DNA的小沟并夹紧小沟，这与RNA中报道的大沟夹紧形成对比，从而更有效地稳定螺旋。这些发现建立了一个在复杂离子环境中量化DNA热力学的单分子框架，有助于理解离子对基因组稳定性的调控，并指导设计离子可调的DNA基纳米结构和递送系统。

documents.title: GSK3beta and Plk1 sequentially phosphorylate ATP-citrate lyase to promote homologous recombination.
meta: Zhou, Shinan; Zhou, Xinyu; Chen, Qinfu; Yuan, Xueying; Zhu, Shukai; Huang, Jun; Wang, Fangwei; Yan, Haiyan
Science advances
documents.summary: 该文研究GSK3beta和Plk1磷酸化ACLY调控同源重组修复，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与课题无关。
documents.abstract: Accurate repair of DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) by homologous recombination (HR) is essential for genome stability. Nuclear production of acetyl-coenzyme A (acetyl-CoA) by ATP-citrate lyase (ACLY) promotes HR, yet how ACLY is regulated during the DNA damage response (DDR) remains unclear. Here, we identify a phosphorylation-dependent signaling axis in which glycogen synthase kinase 3beta (GSK3beta) and Polo-like kinase 1 (Plk1) act sequentially on ACLY to facilitate HR-mediated repair of DSBs induced by ionizing radiation. Following AKT-dependent phosphorylation of ACLY at Ser(455), GSK3beta phosphorylates ACLY at Thr(447), generating a docking site for Plk1, which in turn phosphorylates ACLY at Ser(442). This phosphorylation cascade, enhanced by radiation, sustains histone acetylation, supports the accumulation of BRCA1 and RAD51 at DSBs, and confers cellular resistance to poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibition. Together, our findings define an AKT-GSK3beta-Plk1-ACLY signaling module that links the DDR to nuclear metabolism, revealing a critical mechanism by which kinase signaling facilitates acetyl-CoA-dependent chromatin remodeling to preserve genome integrity. 通过同源重组（HR）精确修复DNA双链断裂（DSBs）对基因组稳定性至关重要。ATP-柠檬酸裂解酶（ACLY）在细胞核中产生的乙酰辅酶A（acetyl-CoA）可促进HR，然而在DNA损伤应答（DDR）过程中ACLY如何被调控仍不清楚。在此，我们鉴定了一个磷酸化依赖性信号轴，其中糖原合酶激酶3beta（GSK3beta）和Polo样激酶1（Plk1）依次作用于ACLY，以促进电离辐射诱导的DSBs的HR介导修复。在AKT依赖性磷酸化ACLY的Ser(455)位点后，GSK3beta磷酸化ACLY的Thr(447)位点，为Plk1生成一个对接位点，随后Plk1磷酸化ACLY的Ser(442)位点。这一受辐射增强的磷酸化级联反应维持了组蛋白乙酰化，支持BRCA1和RAD51在DSBs处的积累，并使细胞对聚（ADP-核糖）聚合酶（PARP）抑制产生抗性。综上，我们的发现定义了一个AKT-GSK3beta-Plk1-ACLY信号模块，该模块将DDR与核代谢联系起来，揭示了激酶信号通过促进乙酰辅酶A依赖性染色质重塑以维持基因组完整性的关键机制。

documents.title: Balanced regulation of UvsX activity and thermostability based on active learning.
meta: Li, Lingsong; Zhang, Lin; Li, Dongxiao; Zhang, Jiaxing; You, Shengping; Su, Rongxin; Qi, Wei
International journal of biological macromolecules
documents.summary: 该文通过主动学习与蛋白语言模型工程化改造UvsX重组酶，结合分子动力学模拟研究其与DNA结合路径及ATP水解耦合机制，虽非典型TF-DNA体系，但聚焦蛋白-DNA互作与动态机理，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
documents.abstract: Recombinase polymerase amplification (RPA) enables isothermal nucleic acid detection. However, the key enzyme UvsX of RPA exhibits suboptimal efficiency at low-temperature conditions and low template concentration. Here, we employed a directed engineering strategy combining energy-based screening and protein language models (PLMs). Through semi rational design and iterative optimization with EVOLVEpro, we obtained a triple mutant, TIG (S233T/A311I/A341G), which achieved 1.89-fold RPA relative activity of the wild-type (WT) at a template concentration of 1 x 10(5) copies reaction(-1), and showed higher amplification activity to WT across 37.5-44.3  degrees C at a template concentration of 1 x 10(4) copies reaction(-1). Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that TIG enhances residue flexibility and remodels the ATP-binding pocket, thereby improving DNA-binding pathway connectivity and strengthening the coupling between ATP hydrolysis and DNA strand exchange. Per-residue energy decomposition and protein structure network analyses further elucidate how key mutations modulate DNA-binding pathways. Finally, under optimized expression conditions (20  degrees C, 12 h, 0.1 mM IPTG), the yield reached 206.87 +/- 3.56 mg L(-1) of TIG. Collectively, this study provides a strategy for UvsX engineering and establishes a foundation for the development of more robust RPA assays. 重组酶聚合酶扩增（recombinase polymerase amplification, RPA）可实现等温核酸检测。然而，RPA的关键酶UvsX在低温条件和低模板浓度下表现出次优效率。在此，我们采用了一种结合能量筛选和蛋白质语言模型（protein language models, PLMs）的定向工程策略。通过半理性设计和基于EVOLVEpro的迭代优化，我们获得了一个三重突变体TIG（S233T/A311I/A341G），其在模板浓度为1 x 10(5) copies reaction(-1)时，RPA相对活性达到野生型（wild-type, WT）的1.89倍，并且在模板浓度为1 x 10(4) copies reaction(-1)时，在37.5-44.3摄氏度范围内表现出比WT更高的扩增活性。分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟揭示，TIG增强了残基灵活性并重塑了ATP结合口袋，从而改善了DNA结合通路连接性，并加强了ATP水解与DNA链交换之间的耦合。每个残基的能量分解和蛋白质结构网络分析进一步阐明了关键突变如何调控DNA结合通路。最后，在优化表达条件（20摄氏度，12小时，0.1 mM IPTG）下，TIG的产量达到206.87 +/- 3.56 mg L(-1)。总体而言，本研究为UvsX工程化提供了一种策略，并为开发更稳健的RPA检测方法奠定了基础。

documents.title: Xiaobanxia decoction, a compound Chinese herbal medicine, attenuates chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting via restoring AMPK/TFEB-mediated BNIP3/NIX mitophagy.
meta: Feng, Lei; Zhai, Ya-Rong; Liang, Wan; Kan, Shao-Jun; Nie, Ke
Journal of integrative medicine
documents.summary: 研究中药复方通过AMPK/TFEB通路调控线粒体自噬缓解化疗呕吐，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，且方法以实验为主，无AI/物理模拟建模。
documents.abstract: OBJECTIVE: Xiaobanxia decoction (XBXD), a classical Chinese antiemetic formula, has potential benefits for treating chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting (CINV). The present study investigates its antiemetic effect and explores the possible mechanisms. METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict potential therapeutic targets and pathways. The efficacy and mechanism of XBXD were evaluated using a cisplatin-induced rat pica model and an intestinal epithelial cell line-6 (IEC-6) cell injury model. Antiemetic effects were assessed by measuring kaolin intake, food consumption, and body weight. Gastric antrum and ileum pathological changes were examined by hematoxylin and eosin staining. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays were used to assess tissue levels of interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), interleukin-18 (IL-18), and reactive oxygen species (ROS). Mitochondrial injury and mitochondrial ROS were evaluated using transmission electron microscopy and fluorescence microscopy. Mitophagy and adenosine monophosphate-activated protein kinase (AMPK)/transcription factor EB (TFEB) pathway activation were assessed using Western blotting and immunofluorescence. RESULTS: Compared with the model group, XBXD significantly reduced kaolin consumption, alleviated gastric antrum and ileum pathological damage, and decreased IL-1beta, IL-18 and ROS levels in both gastric antrum and ileum tissues. XBXD also improved mitochondrial ultrastructural morphology, reduced mitochondrial ROS, and restored mitochondrial membrane potential in vivo and in vitro. Furthermore, XBXD increased the microtubule-associated protein 1 light chain 3-II/-I (LC3-II/LC3-I) ratio, reduced sequestosome-1 (p62) accumulation, and upregulated BCL2/adenovirus E1B 19 kDa interacting protein 3 (BNIP3) and Nip3-like protein X (NIX) expression, indicating restoration of mitophagy. Mechanistically, the AMPK/TFEB signaling pathway was triggered by the XBXD treatment. CONCLUSION: XBXD ameliorates CINV in association with activation of the AMPK/TFEB pathway and the restoration of BNIP3/NIX-mediated mitophagy. Please cite this article as: Feng L, Zhai YR, Liang W, Kan SJ, Nie K. Xiaobanxia decoction, a compound Chinese herbal medicine, attenuates chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting via restoring AMPK/TFEB-mediated BNIP3/NIX mitophagy. J Integr Med. 2026; Epub ahead of print. 目的：小半夏汤（XBXD）是一种经典的中医止吐方剂，对治疗化疗引起的恶心呕吐（CINV）具有潜在益处。本研究探讨其止吐作用并探索可能的机制。方法：采用网络药理学和分子对接预测潜在的治疗靶点和通路。通过顺铂诱导的大鼠异食癖模型和肠上皮细胞系-6（IEC-6）细胞损伤模型评估XBXD的疗效和机制。通过测量高岭土摄入量、食物消耗量和体重来评估止吐效果。采用苏木精-伊红染色检查胃窦和回肠的病理变化。使用酶联免疫吸附试验评估组织中白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）、白细胞介素-18（IL-18）和活性氧（ROS）的水平。使用透射电子显微镜和荧光显微镜评估线粒体损伤和线粒体ROS。使用Western blotting和免疫荧光评估线粒体自噬和腺苷酸活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）/转录因子EB（TFEB）通路的激活。结果：与模型组相比，XBXD显著减少高岭土消耗，减轻胃窦和回肠的病理损伤，并降低胃窦和回肠组织中IL-1β、IL-18和ROS的水平。XBXD还改善了线粒体超微结构形态，减少了线粒体ROS，并在体内和体外恢复了线粒体膜电位。此外，XBXD增加了微管相关蛋白1轻链3-II/-I（LC3-II/LC3-I）的比值，减少了sequestosome-1（p62）的积累，并上调了BCL2/腺病毒E1B 19 kDa相互作用蛋白3（BNIP3）和Nip3样蛋白X（NIX）的表达，表明线粒体自噬得到恢复。机制上，XBXD处理触发了AMPK/TFEB信号通路。结论：XBXD通过激活AMPK/TFEB通路和恢复BNIP3/NIX介导的线粒体自噬来改善CINV。请引用本文为：Feng L, Zhai YR, Liang W, Kan SJ, Nie K. Xiaobanxia decoction, a compound Chinese herbal medicine, attenuates chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting via restoring AMPK/TFEB-mediated BNIP3/NIX mitophagy. J Integr Med. 2026; Epub ahead of print.

documents.title: A Unified Structure-based Deep Learning Framework for High-Throughput Screening of Protein-Binding RNAs
meta: Yihao Zhao; Jing Han; Jike Wang; Jianfeng Chu; Yu Kang; Tingjun Hou
bioRxiv
documents.summary: 提出统一结构深度学习框架PRIS，结合图注意力网络与距离预测，用于高通量筛选蛋白结合RNA，虽聚焦蛋白-RNA互作而非TF-DNA，但其结构建模与结合偏好预测方法对TF-DNA互作研究具有直接借鉴意义。
documents.abstract: Protein-RNA interactions regulate diverse biological processes and are increasingly exploited in therapeutic RNA discovery, but accurate inferences of nucleotide preferences and reliable structure prediction remain challenging. Here, we present PRIS, a unified structure-based deep-learning framework that combines two complementary components: PRISeq for nucleotide probability estimation at each RNA position and PRIScore for residue-nucleotide distance prediction to discriminate native-like from incorrect poses. Both share a feature extractor that integrates an Anti-Symmetric Graph Attention Network (A-GAT) with sparse k-Maximum Inner Product (k-MPI) attention to capture long-range interactions across large graphs. PRIScore improves the selection of native-like protein-RNA predictions generated by AlphaFold3, achieving a top-1 success rate of 81.91% on a docking benchmark, compared to 79.26% for AlphaFold3. The selected structures are then fed into PRISeq, which infers position-specific binding preferences and screens RNA libraries. On a PWM benchmark, PRISeq achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.75, outperforming FoldX, Rosetta-based scoring functions, and NA-MPNN. In virtual screening against MS2 protein, PRISeq screens 129,248 RNA hairpins within 11.95 seconds, achieving the highest EF 0.5% of 14.40, approximately double the best baseline. PRIS also effectively enriches active aptamers against NELF-E and GFP while preserving sequence diversity. By integrating structure selection with binding-preference inference, PRIS provides an efficient framework for large-scale RNA library screening and aptamer design. 蛋白质-RNA相互作用调控多种生物过程，并越来越多地被用于治疗性RNA发现，但核苷酸偏好的准确推断和可靠的结构预测仍具挑战。在此，我们提出PRIS，一个统一的基于结构的深度学习框架，它结合了两个互补组件：用于在每个RNA位置进行核苷酸概率估计的PRISeq，以及用于预测残基-核苷酸距离以区分类天然构象与错误构象的PRIScore。两者共享一个特征提取器，该提取器将反对称图注意力网络（A-GAT）与稀疏k-最大内积（k-MPI）注意力相结合，以捕捉大图上的长程相互作用。PRIScore改进了由AlphaFold3生成的类天然蛋白质-RNA预测的选择，在对接基准测试中实现了81.91%的top-1成功率，而AlphaFold3为79.26%。所选结构随后被输入PRISeq，后者推断位置特异性结合偏好并筛选RNA文库。在PWM基准测试中，PRISeq实现了0.75的平均绝对误差（MAE），优于FoldX、基于Rosetta的评分函数和NA-MPNN。在对MS2蛋白的虚拟筛选中，PRISeq在11.95秒内筛选了129,248个RNA发夹，实现了最高的EF 0.5%为14.40，约为最佳基线的两倍。PRIS还能有效富集针对NELF-E和GFP的活性适配体，同时保持序列多样性。通过将结构选择与结合偏好推断相结合，PRIS为大规模RNA文库筛选和适配体设计提供了一个高效框架。

documents.title: Explainable ML force-field for evaluating protein–ligand binding energy using SO3LR
meta: Hamza Agha; Sergio Suárez-Dou; Adil Kabylda; Alexandre Tkatchenko; Andrea Volkamer
ChemRxiv
documents.summary: 该文提出基于SO3LR等变消息传递网络的机器学习力场评分函数SO3LR-SF，用于蛋白-配体结合能评估，虽非TF-DNA体系，但其物理建模与可解释性框架可迁移至蛋白-DNA互作研究。
documents.abstract: Accurate estimation of protein–ligand binding affinities remains central to structure-based drug design. Classical force fields neglect important quantum-mechanical effects, while quantum mechanical and semi-empirical methods remain impractical for large biomolecular systems. Machine-learned force fields (MLFFs) offer an alternative, but their performance may be inflated by training on protein–ligand complexes. Here, we introduce SO3LR-SF, a physics-based scoring function built on the pretrained SO3LR MLFF, combining an equivariant message-passing network for semi-local interactions with physically motivated terms for short-range repulsion, electrostatics, and long-range dispersion. Built on an MLFF that was not trained on protein–ligand complexes, SO3LR-SF provides a stringent test of transferability. On PLA15 (15 active-site models), SO3LR-SF attains a relative interaction error of 5.8% against DLPNO-CCSD(T) references, the lowest of all tested methods. On the FEP benchmark (8 targets, 264 ligands), SO3LR-SF achieves an average Spearman correlation of 0.51, on par with the best semi-empirical quantum-mechanical method tested (0.47, GFN-FF) and with MMGBSA (0.44), and surpassing Glide (0.27). On the Wang dataset (8 targets, 199 ligands), it reaches 0.51, approaching the 0.60 average of molecular dynamics-based free-energy methods at a fraction of their cost. Each complex is scored in 1–10 seconds on 12 CPU cores, an 80- to 300-fold speedup over comparable MLFFs. An 8 Å trimming protocol reduces runtime threefold without loss of accuracy, and a restrained geometry optimization recovers ranking accuracy for targets with strained input structures. A multi-level explainability framework adds energy decomposition, per-atom energy contributions reported either for ligand or as 2D protein–ligand interaction maps, and 3D binding site visualization. We identified two pocket descriptors that flag applicability before scoring, e.g. polar solvent accessible surface area (SASA) ratio correlating strongly (r = 0.81) with performance. Together, SO3LR-SF presents a fast, interpretable, and competitive scoring function for drug discovery that requires no domain-specific training data. 准确估算蛋白质-配体结合亲和力仍是基于结构的药物设计的核心问题。经典力场忽略了重要的量子力学效应，而量子力学和半经验方法对于大型生物分子体系仍不实用。机器学习力场（MLFFs）提供了一种替代方案，但其性能可能因在蛋白质-配体复合物上训练而被高估。在此，我们提出SO3LR-SF，一种基于预训练SO3LR MLFF的物理评分函数，它将用于半局域相互作用的等变消息传递网络与短程排斥、静电和长程色散等物理动机项相结合。SO3LR-SF构建于未在蛋白质-配体复合物上训练的MLFF之上，提供了对可迁移性的严格测试。在PLA15（15个活性位点模型）上，SO3LR-SF相对于DLPNO-CCSD(T)参考值达到了5.8%的相对相互作用误差，是所有测试方法中最低的。在FEP基准测试（8个靶点，264个配体）上，SO3LR-SF实现了0.51的平均Spearman相关系数，与测试中最佳半经验量子力学方法（0.47，GFN-FF）和MMGBSA（0.44）相当，并优于Glide（0.27）。在Wang数据集（8个靶点，199个配体）上，它达到了0.51，接近基于分子动力学的自由能方法0.60的平均值，而成本仅为后者的极小部分。每个复合物在12个CPU核心上评分需1–10秒，比同类MLFFs快80至300倍。一个8 Å的修剪方案在不损失精度的情况下将运行时间减少三倍，而受约束的几何优化可恢复具有扭曲输入结构的靶点的排序准确性。一个多层级可解释性框架增加了能量分解、以配体或2D蛋白质-配体相互作用图形式报告的每原子能量贡献，以及3D结合位点可视化。我们识别出两个口袋描述符，可在评分前标记适用性，例如极性溶剂可及表面积（SASA）比率与性能强相关（r = 0.81）。总之，SO3LR-SF为药物发现提供了一种快速、可解释且具有竞争力的评分函数，且无需领域特定的训练数据。

documents.title: Integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation to reveal the potential mechanism of Ginsenoside Rg1 on chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
meta: Li, Xinpeng; Xiang, Dandan; Hu, Lingling; Lin, Lingdan; Wang, Guoqiang; Xu, Jing
Scientific reports
documents.summary: 该文利用网络药理学、分子对接和实验验证研究人参皂苷Rg1对COPD的作用机制，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，且未聚焦转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
documents.abstract: Ginsenoside Rg1 (GS Rg1), a natural flavonoid exhibiting anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, holds significant potential for treatment chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD). Nevertheless, the precise mechanisms underlying its therapeutic effects remain to be fully elucidated. This study aimed to explore the role and potential mechanism of GS Rg1 in the treatment of COPD using network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation.Targets related to GS Rg1 and COPD were screened from public databases, and the potential common targets were then imported into the STRING database to construct a protein-protein interaction (PPI) network. Gene ontology (GO) and Kyoto encyclopedia of genes and genomes (KEGG) enrichment analysis were performed to identify key signaling pathways. Molecular docking was employed to predict the binding interactions between GS Rg1 and core targets. A BEAS-2B cell model induced by lipopolysaccharide(LPS) and cigarette smoke extract(CSE) was used to explore the protective mechanisms of GS Rg1. Western blot analysis was conducted to validate the critical targets and pathways involved in the anti-COPD effects of GS Rg1. Network pharmacology analysis revealed 105 common targets between GS Rg1 and COPD. The EGFR/PI3K/AKT and EGFR/STAT3 signaling pathways were selected for further validation. GS Rg1 was demonstrated to effectively inhibit inflammation and mucus hypersecretion in vitro models of COPD. Western blot results showed that GS Rg1 treatment significantly downregulated the expression of proteins involved in the EGFR/PI3K/AKT and EGFR/STAT3 signaling pathway, consistent with the network pharmacology findings. CSE/LPS exposure induces inflammation and oxidative stress in COPD by disrupting the EGFR/PI3K/AKT and EGFR/STAT3 signaling pathways, and GS Rg1 significantly alleviates these effects, which may be partially through regulating the EGFR/PI3K/AKT and EGFR/STAT3 signaling pathway. 人参皂苷Rg1 (GS Rg1)是一种具有抗炎和抗氧化特性的天然黄酮类化合物，在治疗慢性阻塞性肺疾病 (COPD) 方面具有显著潜力。然而，其治疗作用的确切机制仍有待完全阐明。本研究旨在通过网络药理学、分子对接 (molecular docking) 和实验验证，探讨GS Rg1在治疗COPD中的作用及潜在机制。从公共数据库中筛选出与GS Rg1和COPD相关的靶点，然后将潜在共同靶点导入STRING数据库，构建蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用 (PPI) 网络。进行基因本体论 (GO) 和京都基因与基因组百科全书 (KEGG) 富集分析，以识别关键信号通路。采用分子对接预测GS Rg1与核心靶点之间的结合相互作用。利用脂多糖 (LPS) 和香烟烟雾提取物 (CSE) 诱导的BEAS-2B细胞模型，探索GS Rg1的保护机制。通过Western blot分析验证GS Rg1抗COPD作用中涉及的关键靶点和通路。网络药理学分析显示，GS Rg1与COPD之间存在105个共同靶点。选择EGFR/PI3K/AKT和EGFR/STAT3信号通路进行进一步验证。GS Rg1被证明能有效抑制COPD体外模型中的炎症和黏液高分泌。Western blot结果显示，GS Rg1处理显著下调了EGFR/PI3K/AKT和EGFR/STAT3信号通路中相关蛋白的表达，这与网络药理学结果一致。CSE/LPS暴露通过破坏EGFR/PI3K/AKT和EGFR/STAT3信号通路诱导COPD中的炎症和氧化应激，而GS Rg1显著缓解这些效应，这可能部分通过调节EGFR/PI3K/AKT和EGFR/STAT3信号通路实现。

documents.title: Interpretable prediction of nucleic acid-binding proteins using a protein language model.
meta: Kim, Hanjin; Lee, Sung-Gwon; Oh, Jooseong; Kim, Kee K; Kim, Eun-Mi; Park, Chungoo
Bioinformatics advances
documents.summary: 该文用ESM-2蛋白语言模型预测DNA/RNA结合蛋白，虽聚焦蛋白-核酸互作识别，但仅做序列级分类，未涉及TF-DNA结合位点或三维互作机制建模，方法可迁移但深度有限。
documents.abstract: MOTIVATION: Accurate identification of DNA-binding proteins (DBPs) and RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) is critical for elucidating transcriptional and post-transcriptional regulatory mechanisms. However, existing computational approaches often rely on inferred labels or domain-specific annotations, which limit the subsequent generalizability. RESULTS: This study aimed to introduce transformer-based classifiers for human DBPs and RBPs that rely solely on protein sequence information without engineered features or domain constraints. The models were implemented using ESM-2 with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning and trained on experimentally validated datasets, including chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-seq) annotations for DBPs and eCLIP annotations for RBPs. Next, to evaluate biological relevance, we computed value-aware attention (VAT) scores aggregated across transformer layers to interpret model focus. In 20-fold cross-validation, the DBP model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.84 with a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of 0.40, while the RBP model achieved an AUROC of 0.92 with an MCC of 0.46. Proteins predicted as nucleic acid-binding were enriched for known binding domains, and inspection of attention distributions revealed preferential focus on annotated functional regions rather than non-binding segments. These results demonstrate that attention-based protein language models can accurately identify nucleic acid-binding proteins directly from sequence data. Moreover, these models reveal biologically meaningful sequence determinants of binding, establishing an interpretable and scalable framework for proteome-wide characterization of protein-nucleic acid interactions. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Code is available on GitHub (https://github.com/CSB-hub/DRBP). 动机：准确识别DNA结合蛋白（DBPs）和RNA结合蛋白（RBPs）对于阐明转录和转录后调控机制至关重要。然而，现有计算方法通常依赖推断标签或领域特异性注释，这限制了后续的泛化能力。结果：本研究旨在引入基于transformer的分类器，用于人类DBPs和RBPs，这些分类器仅依赖蛋白质序列信息，无需工程化特征或领域约束。模型使用ESM-2结合低秩适应（LoRA）微调实现，并在实验验证的数据集上训练，包括用于DBPs的染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq）注释和用于RBPs的eCLIP注释。接下来，为评估生物学相关性，我们计算了跨transformer层聚合的值感知注意力（VAT）分数，以解释模型关注点。在20折交叉验证中，DBP模型实现了0.84的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）和0.40的马修斯相关系数（MCC），而RBP模型实现了0.92的AUROC和0.46的MCC。被预测为核酸结合的蛋白质富集了已知结合结构域，注意力分布检查显示，模型优先关注注释的功能区域而非非结合片段。这些结果表明，基于注意力的蛋白质语言模型能够直接从序列数据中准确识别核酸结合蛋白。此外，这些模型揭示了具有生物学意义的结合序列决定因素，为蛋白质-核酸相互作用的蛋白质组范围表征建立了一个可解释且可扩展的框架。可用性与实现：代码可在GitHub上获取（https://github.com/CSB-hub/DRBP）。

documents.title: Integrative Transcriptomic Analysis and Functional Validation Implicate GPT2 in Glycolytic Regulation in Polycystic Ovary Syndrome.
meta: Xi, Meili; Luo, Rongkui; Zhang, Jiarong; Huang, Weihong; Ma, Li; Sun, Yunyan; Ren, Aimin
Food science & nutrition
documents.summary: 该研究通过转录组整合与机器学习分析PCOS中糖酵解相关基因，虽涉及转录因子调控网络但核心为代谢表型与GPT2功能验证，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作建模与AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
documents.abstract: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is a heterogeneous endocrine-metabolic disorder characterized by profound disturbances in energy metabolism, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying glycolytic dysfunction remain incompletely understood. Given the essential role of glycolysis in ovarian function and endocrine homeostasis, this study aimed to systematically characterize glycolysis-associated molecular alterations in PCOS and identify key metabolic regulators involved in disease pathogenesis. Transcriptomic datasets GSE34526 and GSE6798 were integrated to identify glycolysis-related differentially expressed genes (GRDEGs). Functional enrichment, immune infiltration, and regulatory network analyzes were performed to characterize the biological features associated with glycolytic dysregulation. Machine learning algorithms, including support vector machine, random forest, logistic regression, and LASSO regression, were applied to prioritize key glycolysis-associated regulators for downstream biological characterization. The functional role of GPT2 was further examined in KGN granulosa cells under PCOS-like conditions. Twelve GRDEGs were consistently dysregulated in PCOS and were predominantly enriched in glycolytic metabolism, ATP generation, and transcriptional regulatory processes. Integrative machine learning analyzes prioritized four key glycolysis-related genes (AMPD3, C5AR1, MLXIPL, and PDLIM7) associated with glycolytic remodeling in PCOS. Immune infiltration analyzes further revealed coordinated metabolic and immune remodeling, while regulatory network analyzes highlighted extensive interactions between hub genes and miRNA-, transcription factor-, and RNA-binding protein-mediated regulatory networks. Functional experiments demonstrated that GPT2 knockdown impaired glycolytic activity, reduced ATP production and aromatase activity, disrupted steroid hormone homeostasis, and exacerbated metabolic dysfunction in granulosa cells, whereas pharmacological activation of glycolysis partially reversed these alterations. Our findings provide a comprehensive characterization of glycolytic dysregulation in PCOS and identify GPT2 as a potential metabolic regulator linking altered energy metabolism to ovarian dysfunction. These findings provide a molecular framework for future studies investigating metabolism- and nutrition-based intervention strategies in PCOS. 多囊卵巢综合征（PCOS）是一种以能量代谢严重紊乱为特征的异质性内分泌代谢疾病，然而糖酵解功能障碍的分子机制仍不完全清楚。鉴于糖酵解在卵巢功能和内分泌稳态中的关键作用，本研究旨在系统表征PCOS中糖酵解相关的分子改变，并识别参与疾病发病机制的关键代谢调控因子。整合转录组数据集GSE34526和GSE6798，以鉴定糖酵解相关差异表达基因（GRDEGs）。进行功能富集、免疫浸润和调控网络分析，以表征与糖酵解失调相关的生物学特征。应用机器学习算法，包括支持向量机、随机森林、逻辑回归和LASSO回归，以优先筛选关键糖酵解相关调控因子用于下游生物学表征。进一步在PCOS样条件下的KGN颗粒细胞中检测GPT2的功能作用。在PCOS中，12个GRDEGs持续失调，且主要富集于糖酵解代谢、ATP生成和转录调控过程。整合机器学习分析优先筛选出四个与PCOS中糖酵解重塑相关的关键糖酵解相关基因（AMPD3、C5AR1、MLXIPL和PDLIM7）。免疫浸润分析进一步揭示了代谢与免疫重塑的协同作用，而调控网络分析则强调了核心基因与miRNA、转录因子和RNA结合蛋白介导的调控网络之间的广泛相互作用。功能实验表明，GPT2敲低损害了糖酵解活性，降低了ATP生成和芳香化酶活性，破坏了类固醇激素稳态，并加剧了颗粒细胞的代谢功能障碍，而糖酵解的药理学激活则部分逆转了这些改变。我们的研究结果提供了PCOS中糖酵解失调的全面表征，并确定GPT2为连接能量代谢改变与卵巢功能障碍的潜在代谢调控因子。这些发现为未来研究PCOS中基于代谢和营养的干预策略提供了分子框架。

documents.title: Transcriptome Analysis and Experimental Validation of Palmitoylation- Related Biomarkers in Atherosclerosis.
meta: Song, Zhijian; Ma, Yirong; Liu, Yanhong; Lai, Junyu; Sun, Liqiang; Li, Qiming; Fan, Yaguo; Huang, Yingying; Ding, Doukun; Wu, Jianguang
Combinatorial chemistry & high throughput screening
documents.summary: 该文通过转录组分析鉴定动脉粥样硬化中棕榈酰化相关生物标志物，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Protein palmitoylation contributes to membrane localisation, signal transduction, and cell-fate regulation. It is closely associated with lipid metabolic dysfunction, immune inflammation, and vascular remodelling in atherosclerosis (AS). However, key palmitoylation-related transcriptomic markers and their potential causal associations with AS remain incompletely defined. METHODS: The Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) dataset GSE100927 was used as the training cohort, and GSE43292 was used as an external validation cohort. Differentially expressed genes were identified using limma and intersected with palmitoylation-related genes to obtain palmitoylation-related differentially expressed genes (PRDEGs). Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analyses were then performed using clusterProfiler. Two-sample Mendelian randomisation was used to evaluate potential causal relationships between characteristic genes and AS. Feature selection was conducted using random forest and support vector machine recursive feature elimination (SVM-RFE), and the overlapping genes selected by both methods were retained. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves were used to assess diagnostic performance. A five-gene nomogram was constructed, and its clinical utility was evaluated using calibration curves and decision curve analysis (DCA). Gene set variation analysis (GSVA) was applied to compare pathway activity between high- and low-expression groups for each core gene. Single-cell analysis using Seurat and expression-based cell-cell communication analysis using CellChat were conducted with GSE159677, and upstream transcription factors were predicted using NetworkAnalyst. For in vivo validation, an AS model was established in ApoE(8)/(8) mice fed a high-fat diet, and aortic gene and protein expression were assessed by RT-qPCR and western blotting. RESULTS: In GSE100927, 51 PRDEGs were identified. GO and KEGG enrichment analyses highlighted pathways associated with regulation of monoatomic ion transport, sarcomere and myofibril organisation, and immune inflammation. Mendelian randomisation suggested a potential protective causal association between SLC7A7 and AS. By integrating MR with random forest and SVM-RFE feature selection, we prioritised five core genes: PLCB2, GMIP, NEXN, PLN, and SLC7A7. These genes showed good diagnostic performance in GSE43292. The resulting nomogram was well calibrated and demonstrated stable net benefit in decision curve and clinical impact curve analyses. Single-gene GSVA identified consistently activated pathways across multiple genes, including innate and adaptive immune recognition, calcium signalling and myocardial contraction/cardiomyopathy, extracellular matrix-receptor interaction, cell junction pathways, autophagy-lysosome pathways, and several metabolic programmes. At the single-cell level, PLCB2 and GMIP were predominantly expressed in T cells and macrophages, NEXN and PLN were enriched in vascular smooth muscle cells, and SLC7A7 was mainly expressed in macrophages. CellChat analysis indicated increased signals for immune-related ligand-receptor interactions. In ApoE(8)/(8) mice fed a high-fat diet, PLCB2, GMIP, and SLC7A7 were upregulated, whereas NEXN and PLN were downregulated; protein-level changes were concordant with the transcriptomic trends. DISCUSSION: These findings indicate that palmitoylation-related dysregulation in AS converges on immune inflammation, calcium signalling/contractile programmes, ECM remodelling, and autophagy-linked metabolism. The five-gene panel is supported by external validation, single-cell localisation to immune and vascular compartments, and concordant results in ApoE(8)/(8) mice. CONCLUSION: This study identified and validated five palmitoylation-related genes associated with AS. SLC7A7 showed a potential protective causal signal in MR analysis. The enriched pathway patterns linked these genes to immune inflammation, calcium signalling-contraction coupling, ECM remodelling, cell adhesion, and autophagy- associated metabolic reprogramming. The five-gene nomogram showed potential utility for diagnostic classification and decision support, nominating candidate biomarkers and pathway targets for AS molecular subtyping, diagnosis, and mechanistic investigation. 引言：蛋白质棕榈酰化参与膜定位、信号转导和细胞命运调控，并与动脉粥样硬化（AS）中的脂质代谢功能障碍、免疫炎症和血管重塑密切相关。然而，关键的棕榈酰化相关转录组标志物及其与AS的潜在因果关联仍未完全明确。方法：采用Gene Expression Omnibus（GEO）数据集GSE100927作为训练队列，GSE43292作为外部验证队列。使用limma识别差异表达基因，并与棕榈酰化相关基因取交集，获得棕榈酰化相关差异表达基因（PRDEGs）。随后使用clusterProfiler进行Gene Ontology（GO）和Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes（KEGG）富集分析。采用两样本孟德尔随机化评估特征基因与AS之间的潜在因果关联。使用随机森林和支持向量机递归特征消除（SVM-RFE）进行特征选择，并保留两种方法选出的重叠基因。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线评估诊断性能。构建五基因列线图，并使用校准曲线和决策曲线分析（DCA）评估其临床效用。应用基因集变异分析（GSVA）比较每个核心基因高、低表达组之间的通路活性。使用Seurat进行单细胞分析，使用CellChat进行基于表达量的细胞间通讯分析，数据来自GSE159677，并使用NetworkAnalyst预测上游转录因子。体内验证方面，在高脂饮食喂养的ApoE(8)/(8)小鼠中建立AS模型，并通过RT-qPCR和western blotting评估主动脉基因和蛋白表达。结果：在GSE100927中，鉴定出51个PRDEGs。GO和KEGG富集分析突出了与单原子离子转运调控、肌节和肌原纤维组织以及免疫炎症相关的通路。孟德尔随机化提示SLC7A7与AS之间存在潜在的保护性因果关联。通过整合MR与随机森林和SVM-RFE特征选择，我们优先确定了五个核心基因：PLCB2、GMIP、NEXN、PLN和SLC7A7。这些基因在GSE43292中表现出良好的诊断性能。所构建的列线图校准良好，并在决策曲线和临床影响曲线分析中显示出稳定的净获益。单基因GSVA识别出多个基因中一致激活的通路，包括先天性和适应性免疫识别、钙信号传导和心肌收缩/心肌病、细胞外基质-受体相互作用、细胞连接通路、自噬-溶酶体通路以及若干代谢程序。在单细胞水平上，PLCB2和GMIP主要在T细胞和巨噬细胞中表达，NEXN和PLN富集于血管平滑肌细胞，SLC7A7主要在巨噬细胞中表达。CellChat分析显示免疫相关配体-受体相互作用的信号增强。在高脂饮食喂养的ApoE(8)/(8)小鼠中，PLCB2、GMIP和SLC7A7上调，而NEXN和PLN下调；蛋白水平变化与转录组趋势一致。讨论：这些发现表明，AS中棕榈酰化相关失调汇聚于免疫炎症、钙信号传导/收缩程序、ECM重塑和自噬相关代谢。五基因组合得到外部验证、单细胞在免疫和血管区室的定位以及ApoE(8)/(8)小鼠中一致结果的支持。结论：本研究鉴定并验证了五个与AS相关的棕榈酰化相关基因。SLC7A7在MR分析中显示出潜在的保护性因果信号。富集的通路模式将这些基因与免疫炎症、钙信号传导-收缩偶联、ECM重塑、细胞粘附和自噬相关代谢重编程联系起来。五基因列线图显示出在诊断分类和决策支持方面的潜在效用，为AS分子分型、诊断和机制研究提名了候选生物标志物和通路靶点。

documents.title: Loss of SUMOylation drives aberrant PRC1 clustering and 3D genome rewiring independent of H3K27me3.
meta: Akilli, Nazli; Puel, Paul-Swann; Stefano, Marco Di; Muzzopappa, Fernando; Fritsch, Lauriane; Erdel, Fabian; Jost, Daniel; Cheutin, Thierry; Cavalli, Giacomo
Nucleic acids research
documents.summary: 该文研究SUMO化修饰对PRC1凝聚体及3D基因组结构的影响，涉及蛋白质凝聚体建模，但核心体系为PRC1与染色质而非TF-DNA特异性结合，且方法以实验和生物物理建模为主，缺乏AI/深度学习或分子动力学模拟等本课题核心方法。
documents.abstract: Polycomb repressive complex 1 (PRC1) forms nuclear condensates that organize target chromatin domains. SUMOylation modulates PRC1 clustering, but its impact on condensate properties and 3D genome architecture remains unclear. Here, we show that depletion of small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMO) in Drosophila wing imaginal discs transforms PRC1 condensates into large structures with reduced molecular dynamics. Biophysical modeling suggests that the changes in PRC1 self-interactions are responsible for the formation of large PRC1 condensates when SUMO is depleted. Interestingly, this biophysical reorganization occurs without global loss of the H3K27me3 mark. Instead, Hi-C reveals widespread rewiring of topologically associating domain (TAD) interactions. PRC1-bound TADs lose specific long-range contacts with each other while gaining ectopic interactions with active chromatin. These topological shifts correlate with gene misregulation independently of changes in Polycomb histone modifications. Our results establish SUMOylation as a critical regulator of PRC1 condensates, demonstrating that post-translational control of biomolecular condensation modulates 3D genome architecture and transcriptional output through mechanisms separable from histone mark deposition. Polycomb repressive complex 1 (PRC1) 形成核凝聚体，组织靶染色质结构域。SUMOylation 调节 PRC1 的聚集，但其对凝聚体性质和 3D 基因组结构的影响仍不清楚。在此，我们展示在果蝇翅成虫盘中，小泛素样修饰因子 (SUMO) 的缺失将 PRC1 凝聚体转变为具有降低分子动力学的大结构。生物物理模型表明，当 SUMO 缺失时，PRC1 自相互作用的改变是形成大 PRC1 凝聚体的原因。有趣的是，这种生物物理重组发生在 H3K27me3 标记未全局丢失的情况下。相反，Hi-C 揭示了拓扑关联结构域 (TAD) 相互作用的广泛重连。PRC1 结合的 TAD 彼此失去特定的长程接触，同时获得与活跃染色质的异位相互作用。这些拓扑变化与基因失调相关，且独立于 Polycomb 组蛋白修饰的变化。我们的结果确立了 SUMOylation 作为 PRC1 凝聚体的关键调节因子，证明通过可分离于组蛋白标记沉积的机制，生物分子凝聚的翻译后控制调节 3D 基因组结构和转录输出。

documents.title: Regulatory Network Unveils the Molecular Architecture Governing Seed Vigor in Watermelon (Citrullus lanatus).
meta: Wu, Xinyi; Cheng, Mengxue; Li, Xuyang; Zhang, Chunyu; Zhou, Yingying; Bai, Bing
The Plant cell
documents.summary: 该文通过多组学整合和机器学习构建西瓜种子活力调控网络，涉及转录因子DOF/ERF与DNA的cis-element互作及分子对接验证，但核心是种子生物学而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法上AI应用较浅，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作但非聚焦TF-DNA结合机制。
documents.abstract: Seed vigor, a determinant of agricultural productivity, diminishes during ageing but can be restored through priming. We integrated multi-omics approaches to dissect molecular mechanisms governing watermelon seed vigor under controlled deterioration and priming. Controlled deterioration (CD) progressively impaired germination speed (t50) and uniformity (AUC) before reducing maximum germination (Gmax), whereas priming reversed these effects even under ageing conditions. Transcriptome analyses revealed that ageing upregulated oxidative-stress genes (e.g., cytochrome c oxidase) and suppressed translation machinery. Priming activated stress-response pathways and ribosomal proteins through DOF/ERF-mediated transcriptional reprogramming via cis-element recognition, and molecular docking and yeast one-hybrid assays confirmed this interaction. Two biomarkers, Cla97C04G070560 (cytochrome c oxidase) and Cla97C03G062270 (ribosomal protein), were identified as quantitative predictors of germination decline. Machine-learning-based proteomic models and a regulatory network, SeedWatermelonNet (SWN), were constructed. These analyses uncovered hub genes (e.g., OHCU_decarbox, HSPs, LIM, NADPH-dependent aldehyde reductase 1, RPL32) coordinating uric acid metabolism, stress responses, energy metabolism, and translation. Experimental validation confirmed the regulatory roles of these candidates, including physical interactions mediating seed-vigor transduction cascades and their predicted function as direct regulators of seed vigor via SWN. Maternal alleles dominated transcriptional regulation of stored mRNAs, with ageing reducing maternal-specific gene expression. Promoter SNPs in these genes implicated BPC and DOF transcription factors in maternal bias. These findings establish molecular thresholds for vigor loss, validate priming as a resilience strategy, and provide biomarkers for seed quality assessment. Integrating transcriptomic, proteomic, and allele-specific insights advances precision breeding and storage practices, offering targets to enhance seed resilience against climate-driven agricultural challenges. 种子活力是农业生产力的决定因素，在老化过程中会下降，但可通过引发处理得以恢复。我们整合了多组学方法，以解析控制西瓜种子在受控劣变和引发条件下活力的分子机制。受控劣变（CD）在降低最大发芽率（Gmax）之前，逐步损害了发芽速度（t50）和均匀性（AUC），而引发处理即使在老化条件下也逆转了这些效应。转录组分析揭示，老化上调了氧化应激基因（如细胞色素c氧化酶）并抑制了翻译机制。引发处理通过DOF/ERF介导的转录重编程（经由顺式元件识别）激活了应激响应通路和核糖体蛋白，分子对接和酵母单杂交实验证实了这一相互作用。两个生物标志物，Cla97C04G070560（细胞色素c氧化酶）和Cla97C03G062270（核糖体蛋白），被鉴定为发芽衰退的定量预测因子。构建了基于机器学习的蛋白质组模型和调控网络SeedWatermelonNet（SWN）。这些分析揭示了枢纽基因（如OHCU_decarbox、HSPs、LIM、NADPH依赖性醛还原酶1、RPL32）协调尿酸代谢、应激响应、能量代谢和翻译。实验验证确认了这些候选基因的调控作用，包括介导种子活力转导级联的物理相互作用及其通过SWN作为种子活力直接调控因子的预测功能。母本等位基因主导了储存mRNA的转录调控，老化降低了母本特异性基因表达。这些基因中的启动子SNP暗示BPC和DOF转录因子参与母本偏向性。这些发现确立了活力丧失的分子阈值，验证了引发作为恢复力策略的有效性，并为种子质量评估提供了生物标志物。整合转录组、蛋白质组和等位基因特异性见解推进了精准育种和储存实践，为增强种子应对气候驱动农业挑战的恢复力提供了靶点。

documents.title: transfactor: transcription factor activity estimation via probabilistic gene expression deconvolution.
meta: Van den Berge, Koen; Bickel, Peter; Dudoit, Sandrine
Biostatistics (Oxford, England)
documents.summary: 该文提出一种基于概率基因表达解卷积的转录因子活性估计方法，虽涉及TF与基因调控，但核心是统计推断而非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且未使用AI或物理模拟方法，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA结合机制研究关联较弱。
documents.abstract: Gene expression is a primary modality being studied to differentiate between biological cells. Contemporary single-cell studies simultaneously measure genome-wide transcription levels for thousands of individual cells in a single experiment. While the characterization of cell population differences has often occurred through differential gene expression analysis, tiny effect sizes become statistically significant when thousands of cells are available for each population, compromising biological interpretation. Moreover, these large studies have spurred the development of methods to infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) directly from the data, and GRN databases are becoming more comprehensive. In this work, we propose a statistical model for gene expression measures and an inference method that leverage GRNs to deconvolve transcription factor (TF) activity from gene expression, by probabilistically assigning mRNA molecules to TFs. This shifts the paradigm from investigating gene expression differences to regulatory differences at the level of TF activity, aiding interpretation and allowing prioritization of a limited number of TFs responsible for significant contributions to the observed gene expression differences. The inferred TF activities result in intuitive prioritization of TFs in terms of the (difference in) estimated number of molecules they produce, in contrast to other widely used methods relying on arbitrary enrichment scores. Our model allows the incorporation of prior information on the regulatory potential between each TF and target gene and is able to deal with both repressing and activating interactions. We compare our approach to other TF activity estimation methods using two simulation experiments and two case studies. Single-cell RNA-sequencing; TF activity; bioinformatics; GRN. 基因表达是研究生物细胞差异的主要手段。当代单细胞研究在一次实验中同时测量数千个个体细胞的基因组-wide转录水平。虽然细胞群体差异的表征通常通过差异基因表达分析实现，但当每个群体有数千个细胞可用时，微小的效应量变得统计显著，从而影响生物学解释。此外，这些大规模研究推动了直接从数据中推断基因调控网络（GRN）的方法发展，且GRN数据库正变得更加全面。在本工作中，我们提出一个针对基因表达测量的统计模型及一种推断方法，利用GRN通过概率性地将mRNA分子分配给转录因子（TF），从基因表达中解卷积转录因子活性。这将研究范式从探究基因表达差异转向TF活性层面的调控差异，有助于解释，并允许优先考虑对观察到的基因表达差异有显著贡献的有限数量的TF。推断出的TF活性在估计产生的分子数量（差异）方面提供了直观的TF优先排序，这与依赖任意富集分数的其他广泛使用的方法形成对比。我们的模型允许纳入每个TF与靶基因之间调控潜力的先验信息，并能处理抑制性和激活性的相互作用。我们通过两个模拟实验和两个案例研究，将我们的方法与其他TF活性估计方法进行比较。单细胞RNA测序；TF活性；生物信息学；GRN。

documents.summary: 该文通过冷冻电镜和AlphaFold建模解析了BRD4与P-TEFb复合物的结构，揭示了转录延伸因子复合物的结合机制，但核心是蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法涉及结构建模但非AI/物理模拟聚焦于DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合与互作机制建模关联度中等。
documents.abstract:
ABSTRACT

Cyclin-dependent kinases (CDK) dynamically regulate RNA Polymerase (Pol) II during each stage of transcription. Phosphorylation of RNA Pol II and associated transcription factors by CDKs enables stage-specific exchange of factors. CDK9 and a cyclin partner (CYCT1, T2 or K) comprise the Positive Transcription Elongation Factor-b (P-TEFb) complex, which is responsible for releasing RNA Pol II from promoter proximal pausing into processive elongation. P-TEFb activity is stimulated by bromodomain-containing Protein 4 (BRD4); however, the structural basis for BRD4 association with P-TEFb has remained unclear. Using cryogenic-electron microscopy, AlphaFold modeling, and biochemical probing, we show that the P-TEFb interacting domain of BRD4 (BRD4-PID) interacts with P-TEFb via the C-lobe of CDK9 and the second cyclin domain of CYCT1. The BRD4 binding surface on CDK9 is also used by super elongation complex component AFF4. Our analysis indicates that BRD4 may stimulate P-TEFb activity by remodeling the kinase αC helix relative to previous structures. Finally, P-TEFb activity is restricted when bound to the 7SK RNP complex. We show that in addition to BRD4-PID, the AFF4 N-terminus can release P-TEFb from the 7SK RNP complex. Together, these findings define how P-TEFb activity is regulated by its incorporation into distinct complexes.

SIGNIFICANCE STATEMENT

The exquisite control of gene expression is required for proper development and cellular response to environmental stress. Positive transcription elongation factor b (P-TEFb) is required for the phosphorylation of RNA Pol II and leads to the coordinated release of RNA Pol II from pause sites near the promoter. P-TEFb is bound to bromo-domain containing protein 4 (BRD4), which stimulates P-TEFb activity; however, it is unknown how BRD4 associates with P-TEFb. Here we report a cryo-EM structure of P-TEFb bound to BRD4, revealing how BRD4 interacts with P-TEFb. Comparison of our structure with previously reported P-TEFb structures shows how P-TEFb is regulated by different transcription factor binding partners.

摘要

细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶 (cyclin-dependent kinases, CDK) 在转录的每个阶段动态调控RNA聚合酶 (RNA Polymerase, Pol) II。CDK对RNA Pol II及相关转录因子的磷酸化使得因子能够进行阶段特异性交换。CDK9与一个细胞周期蛋白伴侣 (CYCT1、T2或K) 构成正性转录延伸因子b (Positive Transcription Elongation Factor-b, P-TEFb) 复合物，该复合物负责将RNA Pol II从启动子近端暂停释放为持续性延伸。P-TEFb的活性由含溴结构域蛋白4 (bromodomain-containing Protein 4, BRD4) 刺激；然而，BRD4与P-TEFb结合的结构基础仍不清楚。利用冷冻电镜 (cryogenic-electron microscopy)、AlphaFold建模和生化探测，我们显示BRD4的P-TEFb相互作用结构域 (BRD4-PID) 通过CDK9的C-lobe和CYCT1的第二个细胞周期蛋白结构域与P-TEFb相互作用。CDK9上的BRD4结合表面也被超级延伸复合物组分AFF4所利用。我们的分析表明，与先前结构相比，BRD4可能通过重塑激酶αC螺旋来刺激P-TEFb活性。最后，当P-TEFb与7SK RNP复合物结合时，其活性受到限制。我们显示，除了BRD4-PID外，AFF4的N-末端也能将P-TEFb从7SK RNP复合物中释放出来。这些发现共同定义了P-TEFb活性如何通过其整合到不同复合物中而受到调控。

意义声明

基因表达的精细调控对于正常发育和细胞对环境胁迫的响应至关重要。正性转录延伸因子b (P-TEFb) 是RNA Pol II磷酸化所必需的，并导致RNA Pol II从启动子附近的暂停位点协调释放。P-TEFb与含溴结构域蛋白4 (BRD4) 结合，后者刺激P-TEFb活性；然而，BRD4如何与P-TEFb结合尚不清楚。在此我们报告了P-TEFb与BRD4结合的冷冻电镜结构，揭示了BRD4如何与P-TEFb相互作用。将我们的结构与先前报道的P-TEFb结构进行比较，显示了P-TEFb如何通过不同的转录因子结合伙伴受到调控。

documents.title: Immune-Like Malignant Epithelial Programs Shape Tumor-Immune Interactions and Inform Prognostic Stratification in Lung Adenocarcinoma.

documents.summary: 该文通过单细胞RNA-seq分析肺腺癌恶性上皮细胞状态，构建免疫样恶性上皮细胞预后签名，但核心是转录组与预后分析，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联度低。
documents.abstract: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) is characterized by marked cellular heterogeneity, yet how malignant epithelial states contribute to immune regulation and clinical outcomes remains incompletely defined. We integrated single-cell RNA-sequencing data to map the cellular landscape of LUAD and identify malignant epithelial cells based on inferred copy-number alterations. Epithelial states were further examined through trajectory inference, transcription factor analysis, and cell-cell communication profiling. Single-cell-derived genes were subsequently integrated with TCGA and independent GEO cohorts to construct and validate a machine learning-based prognostic signature. Malignant epithelial cells displayed distinct functional programs, including an immune-like state associated with genomic instability, immune-related transcriptional activity, tumor-immune communication, and patient outcomes. The resulting immune-like malignant epithelial cell signature (IMEC-Sig) consistently stratified survival across multiple cohorts. Low IMEC-Sig scores were accompanied by greater immune infiltration, higher immune checkpoint expression, and increased immunophenoscore, whereas high scores were linked to a comparatively immunosuppressive phenotype. Pan-cancer analyses further identified KRT8 as a gene associated with unfavorable prognosis, and functional experiments showed that KRT8 silencing suppressed proliferation, migration, invasion, and colony formation in LUAD cells. Together, these findings connect malignant epithelial heterogeneity with the immune context and clinical outcomes, support IMEC-Sig as a biologically informed prognostic tool, and nominate KRT8 as a potential therapeutic target in LUAD. 肺腺癌 (lung adenocarcinoma, LUAD) 以显著的细胞异质性为特征，但恶性上皮状态如何影响免疫调控和临床结局仍不完全明确。我们整合了单细胞RNA测序数据，绘制LUAD的细胞图谱，并基于推断的拷贝数变异识别恶性上皮细胞。通过轨迹推断、转录因子分析和细胞-细胞通讯分析进一步研究了上皮状态。随后将单细胞衍生基因与TCGA及独立GEO队列整合，构建并验证了基于机器学习的预后特征。恶性上皮细胞表现出不同的功能程序，包括一种与基因组不稳定性、免疫相关转录活性、肿瘤-免疫通讯及患者结局相关的免疫样状态。由此产生的免疫样恶性上皮细胞特征 (IMEC-Sig) 在多个队列中一致地实现了生存分层。低IMEC-Sig评分伴随更高的免疫浸润、更高的免疫检查点表达和更高的免疫表型评分，而高评分则与相对免疫抑制的表型相关。泛癌分析进一步将KRT8鉴定为与不良预后相关的基因，功能实验表明，沉默KRT8抑制了LUAD细胞的增殖、迁移、侵袭和集落形成。总之，这些发现将恶性上皮异质性与免疫背景和临床结局联系起来，支持IMEC-Sig作为生物学信息丰富的预后工具，并提名KRT8作为LUAD的潜在治疗靶点。

documents.summary: 该文基于结构建模设计靶向幽门螺杆菌RNA聚合酶与sigma因子互作界面的肽配体，属蛋白质-DNA互作相关转录机制研究，但核心为蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法为结构建模与对接，可借鉴至TF-DNA体系。
documents.abstract: Helicobacter pylori colonize the gastric epithelial cells and poses a strong risk factor for gastric complications like chronic gastritis, ulcer diseases, and gastric cancer. Despite the complex treatment regimens, antibiotic resistance is the primary cause of eradication failure and calls for alternate treatment strategy. This study aims to design peptide ligands that specifically target protein-protein interactions in the transcription machinery of H. pylori. The dissociable sigma-factor known as SigA, which binds with the RNA polymerase (RNAP) core beta-prime subunit (RpoC). This interacting region has been targeted to design specific peptide ligands using structure-based computational methods. The lack of experimental structures necessitated generating structural models for Hp RpoC, Hp SigA and Hp RpoC-SigA complex structure. The complex was built based on hybrid template-based modeling (TBM) techniques. The RpoC-SigA interface has been exploited to design five suitable peptides-three peptides from H. pylori SigA (P1, P2, and P3) and two peptides from the SigA-interacting regions of H. pylori RpoC (P4 and P5). Investigation of the binding affinity of all five peptides suggests that P1, P3, and P5 exhibit significant affinity, indicating a potential hindrance to RNAP interaction with transcription factors prior to holoenzyme formation. These peptides may serve as promising inhibitors against H. pylori infection. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: The online version contains supplementary material available at https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00679-4. 幽门螺杆菌（Helicobacter pylori）定植于胃上皮细胞，是慢性胃炎、溃疡病和胃癌等胃部并发症的强风险因素。尽管有复杂的治疗方案，抗生素耐药性仍是根除失败的主要原因，并需要替代治疗策略。本研究旨在设计特异性靶向幽门螺杆菌转录机制中蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用的肽配体。可解离的sigma因子SigA与RNA聚合酶（RNAP）核心β'亚基（RpoC）结合。该相互作用区域已被靶向，通过基于结构的计算方法设计特异性肽配体。由于缺乏实验结构，需要生成Hp RpoC、Hp SigA及Hp RpoC-SigA复合物结构的结构模型。该复合物基于混合模板建模（TBM）技术构建。RpoC-SigA界面被利用来设计五种合适的肽——三种来自幽门螺杆菌SigA的肽（P1、P2和P3），以及两种来自幽门螺杆菌RpoC的SigA相互作用区域的肽（P4和P5）。对所有五种肽结合亲和力的研究表明，P1、P3和P5表现出显著亲和力，表明在holoenzyme形成前可能阻碍RNAP与转录因子的相互作用。这些肽可能作为针对幽门螺杆菌感染的有前景的抑制剂。补充信息：在线版本包含补充材料，可访问 https://doi.org/10.1007/s40203-026-00679-4。

documents.title: Identification of Integrated Stress Response-Related Biomarkers in Sepsis-Induced Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome.
meta: Gao, Ye; Wang, Ni; Xiao, Zhaoyang

documents.summary: 该研究通过转录组和机器学习筛选脓毒症相关ARDS的应激反应生物标志物，属于纯临床/免疫表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合建模，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis-induced acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is a fatal inflammatory lung injury. The integrated stress response (ISR) may play stage-dependent roles in lung injury, but its clinical relevance in sepsis-induced ARDS remains unclear. We aimed to identify ISR-related biomarkers and explore their potential mechanisms. METHODS: Public transcriptomic datasets of sepsis-induced ARDS were analyzed. Peripheral blood mononuclear cell (PBMC) single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) was used to define key immune cell populations and intercellular communication. Differential expression analyses combined with machine learning were applied to screen ISR-associated biomarkers, and a nomogram was developed as an exploratory tool for ARDS risk stratification. Biomarker expression was validated in a cecal ligation and puncture (CLP)-based rat model representing early sepsis and ARDS-like lung injury. Lung injury was assessed by light and electron microscopy, histological scoring, lung wet/dry weight ratio, and BALF total protein measurement. Gene expression was quantified by qPCR and protein levels by Western blotting. Functional enrichment, immune infiltration, and trajectory analyses were performed to investigate underlying pathways and immune dynamics. The biomarkers were further validated in an independent external dataset. RESULTS: Nuclear factor erythroid 2-like 2 (NFE2L2) and ZFP36L1 were identified as potential ISR-associated biomarkers in sepsis-induced ARDS, and the two-gene nomogram showed good predictive performance. In vivo, peripheral blood Tnf and Il6 mRNA expression increased after CLP, while rats with ARDS-like lung injury exhibited marked lung injury and reduced tight junction markers. Nfe2l2 and Zfp36l1 mRNA levels were elevated in early sepsis but decreased in established ARDS-like lung injury, while their protein levels were generally reduced in established ARDS-like lung injury compared with early sepsis. Canonical ISR activation markers, including the p-eukaryotic translation initiation factor 2alpha (eIF2alpha)/total eIF2alpha ratio and Atf4, Ddit3/Chop, and Ppp1r15 a/Gadd34 expression, progressively increased from early sepsis to ARDS-like lung injury. Enrichment analyses implicated multiple ISR-related pathways. Immune infiltration analysis revealed altered immune cell composition, with NFE2L2 negatively correlated with activated B cell infiltration. Single-cell trajectory analysis demonstrated dynamic expression of these biomarkers during differentiation of key immune cell subsets. CONCLUSION: NFE2L2 and ZFP36L1 are potential ISR-associated biomarkers in sepsis-induced ARDS and may contribute to disease progression through stress-response regulation and immune modulation, supporting biomarker-driven risk stratification and providing a foundation for future mechanistic and interventional studies. 背景：脓毒症诱导的急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）是一种致死性炎症性肺损伤。整合应激反应（ISR）可能在肺损伤中发挥阶段依赖性作用，但其在脓毒症诱导的ARDS中的临床相关性仍不清楚。我们旨在识别ISR相关生物标志物并探索其潜在机制。方法：分析了脓毒症诱导的ARDS的公共转录组数据集。使用外周血单个核细胞（PBMC）单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）来定义关键免疫细胞群和细胞间通讯。结合机器学习的差异表达分析用于筛选ISR相关生物标志物，并开发了一个列线图作为ARDS风险分层的探索性工具。在基于盲肠结扎穿刺（CLP）的大鼠模型中验证了生物标志物的表达，该模型代表早期脓毒症和ARDS样肺损伤。通过光镜和电镜、组织学评分、肺湿/干重比以及BALF总蛋白测量评估肺损伤。通过qPCR定量基因表达，通过Western blotting定量蛋白水平。进行了功能富集、免疫浸润和轨迹分析以研究潜在通路和免疫动态。在独立的外部数据集中进一步验证了生物标志物。结果：核因子红细胞2相关因子2（NFE2L2）和ZFP36L1被确定为脓毒症诱导的ARDS中潜在的ISR相关生物标志物，双基因列线图显示出良好的预测性能。在体内，CLP后外周血Tnf和Il6 mRNA表达增加，而ARDS样肺损伤大鼠表现出明显的肺损伤和紧密连接标志物减少。Nfe2l2和Zfp36l1 mRNA水平在早期脓毒症中升高，但在已建立的ARDS样肺损伤中降低，而其蛋白水平在已建立的ARDS样肺损伤中与早期脓毒症相比普遍降低。经典的ISR激活标志物，包括磷酸化真核翻译起始因子2α（p-eIF2α）/总eIF2α比值以及Atf4、Ddit3/Chop和Ppp1r15a/Gadd34的表达，从早期脓毒症到ARDS样肺损伤逐渐增加。富集分析涉及多个ISR相关通路。免疫浸润分析显示免疫细胞组成改变，其中NFE2L2与活化B细胞浸润呈负相关。单细胞轨迹分析显示这些生物标志物在关键免疫细胞亚群分化过程中的动态表达。结论：NFE2L2和ZFP36L1是脓毒症诱导的ARDS中潜在的ISR相关生物标志物，可能通过应激反应调节和免疫调节促进疾病进展，支持生物标志物驱动的风险分层，并为未来的机制和干预研究提供基础。

documents.title: An antioxidant and hepatoprotective peptide derived from peony seed meal: Dual mechanisms through activation of the Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 pathway and inhibition of mitochondrial apoptosis.
meta: Wang, Bing; Fei, Bo; Yan, Xueshan; Xiao, Zhenxiang; Dong, Yingying; Jiang, Ting; Shao, Shuai; Yan, Mingming
Food research international (Ottawa, Ont.)
documents.summary: 该文研究牡丹籽粕抗氧化肽AT-8通过Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1通路保护肝细胞，属于纯蛋白-小分子肽功能研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
documents.abstract: Peony seed meal (PSM), a byproduct of peony seed oil processing, is rich in protein but is currently used primarily as animal feed in the livestock industry, leaving its protein resources largely underutilized. Herein, PSM was used as the raw material, and a combination of ultrasound-assisted enzymatic hydrolysis and ultrafiltration was employed to prepare a naturally active peptide fraction (PSMPH) from PSM protein (PSMP). Compared with PSMP, PSMPH demonstrated superior structural characteristics and antioxidant activity. Using liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry, bioactivity prediction, and molecular docking analyses, the peptide AT-8 (APGGYGGT) was identified as a potential antioxidant candidate from PSMPH and subsequently synthesized using solid-phase synthesis. Safety evaluation further confirmed that AT-8 produced no cytotoxic side effects in five normal somatic cell lines. In H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative damage in LO2 hepatocytes, AT-8 significantly reduced alanine aminotransferase, aspartate aminotransferase, and malondialdehyde levels while upregulating the activities of superoxide dismutase, catalase, and glutathione peroxidase compared with PSMPH. Pathway-specific validation further demonstrated that AT-8 exerts hepatoprotective effects through a cascade mechanism involving Nrf2-HO-1 activation, enhanced antioxidant defense, and indirect inhibition of Bax/caspase-3. This study identified AT-8 as an antioxidant hepatoprotective peptide derived from PSM and systematically elucidated its molecular mechanism of action, thereby providing a scientific basis for the high-value utilization of PSM. 牡丹籽粕（PSM）是牡丹籽油加工的副产物，富含蛋白质，但目前主要用作畜牧业的动物饲料，其蛋白质资源未得到充分利用。本研究以PSM为原料，采用超声辅助酶解与超滤相结合的方法，从PSM蛋白（PSMP）中制备了天然活性肽组分（PSMPH）。与PSMP相比，PSMPH表现出更优的结构特性和抗氧化活性。通过液相色谱-串联质谱、生物活性预测和分子对接分析，从PSMPH中鉴定出肽AT-8（APGGYGGT）作为潜在的抗氧化候选物，并随后采用固相合成法进行合成。安全性评价进一步证实，AT-8在五种正常体细胞系中未产生细胞毒性副作用。在H(2)O(2)诱导的LO2肝细胞氧化损伤中，与PSMPH相比，AT-8显著降低了丙氨酸氨基转移酶、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶和丙二醛水平，同时上调了超氧化物歧化酶、过氧化氢酶和谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶的活性。通路特异性验证进一步表明，AT-8通过涉及Nrf2-HO-1激活、增强抗氧化防御以及间接抑制Bax/caspase-3的级联机制发挥肝保护作用。本研究鉴定出AT-8为源自PSM的抗氧化肝保护肽，并系统阐明了其分子作用机制，从而为PSM的高值化利用提供了科学依据。

documents.title: Single cell transcriptomic analysis by deep learning identifies novel microglial transcription regulations in Alzheimer's Disease.
meta: Trivedi, Maitry Ronakbhai; Shah, Jay; Su, Yi; Reiman, Eric M; Wu, Teresa; Wang, Qi

documents.summary: 该文用深度学习分析单细胞转录组数据构建AD疾病轨迹，并基于SHAP识别关键基因构建转录调控网络，但核心是转录组分类与基因调控网络推断，而非直接研究TF-DNA结合与互作机制，且缺乏三维结构建模或物理模拟方法。
documents.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has been increasingly applied to investigate genetic irregularities associated with Alzheimer's Disease (AD). However, its potential to uncover deeper, more detailed molecular and cellular mechanisms remains underexplored, primarily due to limitations in integrating large-scale data and capturing the complex, cell-type-specific dynamics involved in AD pathology. Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) has emerged as a powerful tool in transcriptomics, offering high-resolution, cell-specific insights into complex biological systems. Despite this advancement, a significant gap remains in identifying both common and cell-type-specific transcriptomic signatures that define AD-related cellular and molecular processes. To address this, we propose a deep learning framework leveraging a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) to classify AD versus control nuclei using scRNA-seq data from the Religious Orders Study/Memory and Aging Project (ROSMAP). We focus on microglial subclusters, particularly those representing homeostatic and activated states, to train the MLP model for optimal classification performance. We utilize the predicted embeddings from the MLP to model a disease progression trajectory for each of the datasets. Our model demonstrates strong performance in both classification and disease trajectory inference. To enhance interpretability, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) are applied to identify key AD-associated genes. Based on the most salient genes implicated in AD, we built transcription gene regulatory networks, revealing novel transcription factors and regulons for AD pathogenesis. These regulons highlight profound impacts of dysregulations of proteostasis, endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress responses, and circadian rhythm on synaptic plasticity and neuronal survival in AD, offering a more holistic approach to drug target discovery compared to conventional single-target strategies, potentially leading to greater efficacy in slowing or reversing disease progression. This work demonstrates the transformative potential of AI in elucidating the molecular mechanisms of AD, offering improvements over traditional methods and uncovering novel insights into disease pathogenesis and potential therapeutic targets. 人工智能（AI）已被越来越多地应用于研究阿尔茨海默病（AD）相关的遗传异常。然而，其在揭示更深层、更详细的分子和细胞机制方面的潜力仍未得到充分探索，这主要受限于整合大规模数据以及捕捉AD病理中涉及的复杂、细胞类型特异性动态的局限性。单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）已成为转录组学中的强大工具，为复杂生物系统提供高分辨率、细胞特异性的见解。尽管有这一进展，但在识别定义AD相关细胞和分子过程的常见及细胞类型特异性转录组特征方面，仍存在显著空白。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种深度学习框架，利用多层感知器（MLP）对来自宗教秩序研究/记忆与衰老项目（ROSMAP）的scRNA-seq数据进行AD与对照细胞核的分类。我们聚焦于小胶质细胞亚群，特别是代表稳态和激活状态的亚群，以训练MLP模型实现最佳分类性能。我们利用MLP预测的嵌入来为每个数据集建模疾病进展轨迹。我们的模型在分类和疾病轨迹推断方面均表现出强劲性能。为增强可解释性，应用SHapley加性解释（SHAP）来识别关键的AD相关基因。基于与AD相关的最显著基因，我们构建了转录基因调控网络，揭示了AD发病机制中的新型转录因子和调控子。这些调控子凸显了蛋白质稳态失调、内质网（ER）应激反应和昼夜节律对AD中突触可塑性和神经元存活的深远影响，与传统单靶点策略相比，为药物靶点发现提供了更全面的方法，可能在减缓或逆转疾病进展方面具有更高疗效。这项工作展示了AI在阐明AD分子机制方面的变革潜力，提供了优于传统方法的改进，并揭示了疾病发病机制和潜在治疗靶点的新见解。

documents.title: Binding analysis of the response regulator NarL protein to the promoter of the O(6)-methylguanine-DNA methyltransferase (ogt) gene in Salmonella Typhimurium.
meta: Sahoo, Pravas Ranjan; Kumar, Ajay; Pashupathi, M; Sahoo, Jyochhna Rani
Molecular biology reports
documents.summary: 该文通过EMSA、ITC和分子对接研究NarL转录因子与ogt启动子的结合，属TF-DNA互作体系，但方法以实验为主、分子对接较简单，AI/物理模拟深度不足。
documents.abstract: BACKGROUND: Salmonella Typhimurium (STM) is a gram-negative bacterium that causes severe gastrointestinal disorders in both animals and humans. The regulation of DNA repair genes is critical for maintaining genomic stability of the bacteria. O(6)-methylguanine DNA methyltransferase (Ogt), plays a vital role in repairing alkylated DNA in STM; however, the transcriptional regulation of ogt gene remains poorly characterized. Furthermore, NarL is a transcriptional regulator, involved in the pathogenesis of STM under anaerobic condition. Therefore, this study investigated the interaction between NarL protein and the promoter region of the ogt gene. METHODS: In this study, narl gene was cloned in pET32a vector and NarL protein was expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3). Subsequently, the ogt gene promoter (pogt) was selected, amplified, cloned and its activity was evaluated. Electrophoretic mobility shift assay (EMSA), isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC), molecular docking were employed to elucidate the interaction between NarL protein and ogt promoter. Furthermore, the regulatory role of NarL in ogt gene expression was validated in vivo using RT-qPCR and beta-galactosidase assay. RESULTS: This study resulted that NarL protein interacts specifically with the ogt promoter, as confirmed by EMSA and ITC, with DeltaG of - 9.42 kcal mol(-)(1). Furthermore, RT-qPCR and beta-galactosidase assays demonstrated that deletion of narl significantly (P </= 0.01) decreased ogt transcript levels and promoter activity than wild Salmonella Typhimurium, whereas exogenous supplementation of recombinant NarL protein restored the expression. These findings suggest that NarL plays a potential regulatory role in ogt gene expression in response to environmental signals. CONCLUSION: These findings highlight an interaction between NarL protein and the promoter region of ogt gene in Salmonella Typhimurium, linking nitrogen metabolism with the DNA repair pathway in STM, which may contribute to the bacterial survival under nitrosative stress. 背景：鼠伤寒沙门氏菌（Salmonella Typhimurium, STM）是一种革兰氏阴性细菌，可引起动物和人类的严重胃肠道疾病。DNA修复基因的调控对于维持细菌的基因组稳定性至关重要。O(6)-甲基鸟嘌呤DNA甲基转移酶（Ogt）在STM中修复烷基化DNA中发挥关键作用；然而，ogt基因的转录调控机制仍鲜有表征。此外，NarL是一种转录调控因子，参与STM在厌氧条件下的致病性。因此，本研究探讨了NarL蛋白与ogt基因启动子区域之间的相互作用。方法：在本研究中，将narl基因克隆至pET32a载体中，并在大肠杆菌BL21 (DE3)中表达NarL蛋白。随后，选择、扩增并克隆ogt基因启动子（pogt），并评估其活性。采用电泳迁移率变动分析（EMSA）、等温滴定量热法（ITC）和分子对接来阐明NarL蛋白与ogt启动子之间的相互作用。此外，通过RT-qPCR和β-半乳糖苷酶测定法在体内验证了NarL在ogt基因表达中的调控作用。结果：本研究结果表明，NarL蛋白与ogt启动子特异性相互作用，经EMSA和ITC确认，ΔG为-9.42 kcal mol⁻¹。此外，RT-qPCR和β-半乳糖苷酶测定表明，与野生型鼠伤寒沙门氏菌相比，narl缺失显著（P ≤ 0.01）降低了ogt转录水平和启动子活性，而外源补充重组NarL蛋白则恢复了表达。这些发现表明，NarL在响应环境信号时对ogt基因表达具有潜在调控作用。结论：这些发现强调了鼠伤寒沙门氏菌中NarL蛋白与ogt基因启动子区域之间的相互作用，将氮代谢与STM中的DNA修复途径联系起来，这可能有助于细菌在亚硝化应激下的生存。

documents.title: BpCYCD3;1 regulates organ growth by activating the cell cycle module in white birch.
meta: Yue, Linan; Wang, Xinyu; Zheng, Zhimin
Plant science : an international journal of experimental plant biology
documents.summary: 该文研究白桦中BpCYCD3;1通过激活CDKA-RBR-E2F模块调控器官生长，涉及E2F转录因子与下游启动子结合，但核心是细胞周期调控而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，且方法以实验为主，仅含简单对接分析，与课题聚焦的AI/物理模拟方法不匹配。
documents.abstract: Cyclin D proteins are key regulators of cell cycle progression and plant growth. Here, we identified BpCYCD3;1, a CYCD3 family member in birch, and investigated its function. Phylogenetic and sequence analyses showed that BpCYCD3;1 is evolutionarily conserved and contains canonical cell cycle-related domains. Promoter and expression analyses suggested responsiveness to environmental and hormonal signals, with preferential expression in leaves. BpCYCD3;1 overexpression promoted leaf expansion and biomass accumulation, whereas CRISPR/Cas9 knockout reduced vegetative growth. Cytological analyses revealed increased cell density and epidermal cell number in overexpression lines, indicating enhanced cell proliferation. At the molecular level, BpCYCD3;1 upregulated G1/S transition regulators and DNA replication-related genes. Yeast two-hybrid and docking analyses suggested interaction between BpCYCD3;1 and CDKA;1, as well as the interaction between RBR and E2F transcription factors, and binding of E2FA/E2FB to downstream promoters. Together, these results indicate that BpCYCD3;1 promotes vegetative growth by activating the CDKA-RBR-E2F regulatory module, providing a potential target for improving tree growth and biomass production. Cyclin D蛋白是细胞周期进程和植物生长的关键调控因子。本研究鉴定了桦树中CYCD3家族成员BpCYCD3;1，并探究了其功能。系统发育和序列分析表明，BpCYCD3;1在进化上保守，并包含典型的细胞周期相关结构域。启动子和表达分析提示其对环境和激素信号具有响应性，且在叶片中优先表达。BpCYCD3;1过表达促进了叶片扩展和生物量积累，而CRISPR/Cas9敲除则减少了营养生长。细胞学分析显示，过表达株系中细胞密度和表皮细胞数量增加，表明细胞增殖增强。在分子水平上，BpCYCD3;1上调了G1/S期转换调控因子和DNA复制相关基因。酵母双杂交和对接分析提示BpCYCD3;1与CDKA;1之间存在相互作用，以及RBR与E2F转录因子之间的相互作用，并且E2FA/E2FB与下游启动子结合。综上，这些结果表明BpCYCD3;1通过激活CDKA-RBR-E2F调控模块促进营养生长，为改善树木生长和生物量生产提供了潜在靶点。

documents.title: Bioinformatics Screening and Preliminary Experimental Verification of Integrated Stress Response-Associated MYC and BAG3 in Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease.
meta: Liu, Xueping; Wang, Lu; Tang, Ting; Qian, Hang; He, Binfeng; Xu, Zhi; Wang, Guansong; Zhang, Mingzhou
International journal of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
documents.summary: 该文通过生物信息学筛选COPD中ISR相关生物标志物MYC和BAG3，虽涉及转录因子（如SNAI2）的关联分析，但核心是表达差异和诊断模型，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作机制、结合位点预测或三维结构建模，且方法以统计和机器学习为主，无AI/物理模拟聚焦于TF-DNA互作，与本课题关联度低。
documents.abstract: BACKGROUND: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) has high morbidity and mortality, and integrated stress response (ISR) participates in its progression. Traditional COPD diagnosis relies mainly on GOLD criteria, while ISR-based auxiliary molecular markers are still lacking. This study aimed to comprehensively analyze and identify ISR-related biomarkers in COPD, and to uncover their underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: COPD data were obtained from the GEO database. Biomarkers were identified and validated through a comprehensive approach, including differential expression analysis, machine learning algorithms, expression level verification, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis. Moreover, a nomogram was applied to construct an ISR-related predictive model for COPD. Enrichment analysis, immune infiltration analysis, molecular regulatory network, and drug prediction were performed to further confirm the regulatory roles of biomarkers. Furthermore, the expression patterns of biomarkers in core cells were investigated using dataset GSE173896. Furthermore, Western blotting was employed to detect the protein expression levels of biomarkers in clinical samples. RESULTS: Overall, 2 biomarkers (MYC and BAG3) were identified as significantly associated with ISR in COPD. A predictive nomogram constructed based on MYC and BAG3 demonstrated excellent diagnostic performance, with an area under the curve (AUC) value of 0.799. The biomarkers were significantly enriched in the MAPK signaling pathway and cell cycle. Notably, biomarkers were positively correlated with effector memory CD4 T cells and eosinophils. Subsequently, 36 microRNAs (miRNAs) (like hsa-miR-4699-3p), 260 transcription factors (TFs) (like SNAI2, ZBTB43, and ZNF395) and 9 drugs (like staurosporine and N-acetyl-L-cysteine) were associated with the biomarkers. Moreover, significant changes in MYC and BAG3 expression were observed during T cell differentiation. Clinically, MYC and BAG3 were significantly upregulated in COPD tissues, with protein levels increased by 58.4% and 252.2% respectively. CONCLUSION: This study identified and preliminarily verified ISR-associated MYC and BAG3, offering novel molecular references to complement conventional COPD clinical assessment. 背景：慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）具有高发病率和死亡率，整合应激反应（ISR）参与其进展。传统COPD诊断主要依赖GOLD标准，而基于ISR的辅助分子标志物仍缺乏。本研究旨在全面分析并识别COPD中与ISR相关的生物标志物，并揭示其潜在分子机制。方法：COPD数据来自GEO数据库。通过综合方法（包括差异表达分析、机器学习算法、表达水平验证和受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线分析）识别并验证生物标志物。此外，应用列线图构建COPD的ISR相关预测模型。通过富集分析、免疫浸润分析、分子调控网络和药物预测进一步确认生物标志物的调控作用。进一步利用数据集GSE173896研究生物标志物在核心细胞中的表达模式。此外，采用Western blotting检测临床样本中生物标志物的蛋白表达水平。结果：总体而言，2个生物标志物（MYC和BAG3）被识别为与COPD中ISR显著相关。基于MYC和BAG3构建的预测列线图表现出优异的诊断性能，曲线下面积（AUC）值为0.799。生物标志物显著富集于MAPK信号通路和细胞周期。值得注意的是，生物标志物与效应记忆CD4 T细胞和嗜酸性粒细胞呈正相关。随后，36个微小RNA（miRNA）（如hsa-miR-4699-3p）、260个转录因子（TF）（如SNAI2、ZBTB43和ZNF395）和9种药物（如星形孢菌素和N-乙酰-L-半胱氨酸）与生物标志物相关。此外，在T细胞分化过程中观察到MYC和BAG3表达的显著变化。临床上，MYC和BAG3在COPD组织中显著上调，蛋白水平分别增加58.4%和252.2%。结论：本研究识别并初步验证了ISR相关的MYC和BAG3，为补充传统COPD临床评估提供了新的分子参考。
